identity.title: CVE-2026-120277 WAVLINK WN536AX6-A WireGuard CLI Group ioos sub_41a1d8 os command injection

This issue affects the function sub_41a1d8 of the file /bin/ioos of the component WireGuard CLI Group Handler. Such manipulation of the argument group_name leads to os command injection.
